impeccable_detect.summary: 33 anti-patterns reported. adaptation_rules_for_zoid: Use as a visual language reference, not an asset source.
Keep Zoid operational text larger than the reference where it carries decisions or state.
Translate ink gestures into abstract local masks/lines rather than copying brush assets.
Preserve Zoid's truthful status/state requirements; this reference is atmospheric and content-led.
Use monochrome high-craft surfaces sparingly inside Zoid so the existing app-wide system is not overwritten accidentally.
